en: Taqi al-Din Ahmad ibn Ali al-Maqrizi
ar: تقي الدين أحمد بن علي المقريزي

description.tr: Kahire'nin yazılmış en ayrıntılı topografik tarihini üretti — ortaçağ Kahire'sini modern öncesi dünyanın en iyi belgelenmiş şehri yaparak || Makrîzî'nin Hıtat'ı Kahire'deki her yapıyı, sokağı ve kurumu belgeledi. || [Tarih notu] Wiet'in (1911-27) kısmi çevirisi Makrîzî'nin Memlük çalışmaları için vazgeçilmezliğini belirledi.
description.en: Produced the most detailed topographical history of Cairo ever written — documenting every mosque, madrasa, hospital, street and monument, making medieval Cairo the best-documented city in the pre-modern world || Maqrizi's Khitat documented every building, street, and institution in Cairo, creating what source material calls 'the best-documented medieval city.' His economic analysis of Mamluk fiscal policy anticipated modern economic history methodology. || [Historiographical note] Wiet's (1911-27) partial translation established Maqrizi's indispensability for Mamluk studies. Rabbat (2010) demonstrated his urban history methodology was centuries ahead of European equivalents.
description.ar: أنتج أكثر تاريخ طبوغرافي تفصيلي للقاهرة — جعل القاهرة الوسيطة أفضل مدينة موثّقة || وثّقت خطط المقريزي كل مبنى وشارع ومؤسسة في القاهرة. تحليله الاقتصادي للسياسة المالية المملوكية سبق منهجية التاريخ الاقتصادي الحديث
